name: webull-trade
description: Order-intent channel: draft_order writes a validated, previewed order to data/intents/ (JSON, place it by hand). place_order (opt-in, OFF unless WEBULL_TRADE_CODEWORD is set in .env) directly places a REAL order under a secret codeword + per-order $ cap. Credentials + the codeword load from the repo .env; no secrets stored here.
